interface.signature: arr: List[str], n: int, k: int, str: str -> int

preconditions.description: The size of the array n must be between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(arr[i]) <= 1000 for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: Each string in the array arr must have a length between 1 and 1000.
The integer k must be between 1 and 1000 and must not exceed the length of the string str.

preconditions.expression: all(c.islower() for c in str) and all(c.islower() for s in arr for c in s)
preconditions.description: All characters in the string str and the strings in the array arr must be lowercase English alphabets.

postconditions.description: The output must be the count of strings in arr whose prefix of length k matches the k-length prefix of str.
